title: Spyglass Tool Now Generally Available
summary: The highly anticipated Spyglass tool has officially launched, moving beyond its beta phase to bring its full suite of capabilities to all users.

title: Enhanced File Management
summary: Take command of your content with our new file management system, allowing you to easily upload, remove, download, and customize how images and documents appear in your editor.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: Our new public roadmap page offers complete transparency into what we've shipped, what's coming next, and what's on the horizon, keeping you informed and engaged with our progress.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes for Effortless Task Management
summary: We've completely redesigned checkboxes to be larger, easier to click, and fully draggable, providing a significantly smoother and more intuitive way to manage your tasks.

title: Enhanced Collaboration Experience
summary: Experience seamless teamwork with enhanced real-time collaboration features that make working together effortless and intuitive.

title: Effortless Discovery of Shared Content
summary: Easily find and collaborate on shared ideas and quests with your connections, thanks to enhanced visibility and search capabilities.

title: Noeko Speaks Your Language
summary: Experience Noeko fully as we introduce robust support for multiple international languages, welcoming users from around the world.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source
summary: Noeko's software is now open and freely available, empowering you with greater control, fostering direct community involvement, and ensuring maximum transparency in its exciting future.

title: Dynamic Constellation View
summary: Explore your knowledge base with unprecedented clarity and control as the Constellation view gains powerful new filters for tags and time, alongside seamless sharing options with your network.

title: Precision Search & Personalized Collections
summary: Empower your workflow by effortlessly filtering your knowledge and saving precise searches as personalized collections for future reference.

title: Dynamic Content Linking
summary: We're introducing flexible new ways to display and interact with your linked notes, making it easier to structure information visually.

title: Noeko Self-Hosting and Premium Features Unleashed
summary: Empower your team with flexible self-hosting options and unlock advanced features through our new premium plans.

title: Stunning New Themes and Fresh Designs
summary: Discover a refreshed visual experience with beautifully polished existing themes and an exciting array of new, vibrant design options to personalize your workspace.

title: Smart Time-of-Day Greetings
summary: We're enhancing your homepage experience with smarter greetings that always accurately reflect the time of day, making every login feel perfectly personalized.

title: Enhanced Tag Management
summary: Take direct control of your tagged content with new bulk actions that let you effortlessly unapply tags and manage items right from the tag view, significantly boosting your efficiency.

title: Unlock More Content Types
summary: Effortlessly bring diverse content such as YouTube videos, websites, and text directly into your workflow, transforming how you capture and utilize information.
